shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure with elaborate headdress
circular disc / roundel ornament on the chest or torso
banded or striped rectangular panels of texture
symmetrical composition about a vertical axis
justification: Both show a frontal, vertically symmetrical anthropomorphic figure with a broad banded headdress above and a prominent circular disc or roundel at the chest, and both are executed in shallow relief with raised contour lines. The biggest differences are in medium and density: A is a weathered, monolithic stone block with sparse, eroded motifs and a plain lower body, whereas B is a crisp, brightly rendered green plaque crowded with feathered lateral fans, secondary faces and dense ornament filling the entire field.
